title: Drift-aware eval gates with shadow-traffic reversion playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a drift-aware evaluation gate that uses shadow traffic and sequential A/B testing to detect quality regressions for config and model changes. When the gate detects a statistically significant degradation for defined cohorts it should trigger an automated rollback of the changed config/model variant, or fall back to a compatible model flavor. This ticket covers design, implementation of controller hooks, telemetry, operational playbooks, and integration with the rollout orchestrator.
acceptance_criteria: Controller evaluates canary and A/B cohorts using pre-defined metric sets within a decision window
Shadow traffic pipeline mirrors 5-20% of production requests to new variants without affecting latency of primary path
Sequential testing (alpha spending) configured to limit false positives and produces explainable p-values/CI for each metric
Automatic rollback policy executes within SLO for the route and emits a structured event with provenance (which config, model, metrics, thresholds)
Observability dashboard displays cohort-level drift scores, per-metric contributors, and rollout health in Console
Playbook includes manual override, post-rollback diagnostics, and suggested mitigation steps
design_notes: Use shadow traffic to avoid cold-start interference: mirror requests post-auth but pre-inference so falling back is non-disruptive
Adopt a sequential analysis method (e.g., alpha-spending or Bayesian sequential test) to support early stopping with controlled Type I error

Define metric families: fidelity (exact-match/semantic similarity), safety (toxicity/regeneration rate), latency percentiles, and cost per token. Each metric has a direction and weight for aggregated decision score
Drift detector uses KL-divergence on embedding distributions per cohort to raise soft alerts that adjust thresholds dynamically
Rollback action supports two modes: immediate revert to previous config OR progressive traffic reallocation to fallback model variants over a 2-10 minute window
Provenance: every gate decision must record model version, config diff, prompt cohort definition, timestamps, sample size, and raw metric deltas
implementation_plan: API: extend rollout controller to accept a new 'eval_gate' block (policy, metrics, decision_window, sample_rate, method)
Telemetry: add event types 'eval.sample', 'eval.metric', 'eval.decision', and 'eval.rollback' to ingestion pipeline
Runtime: implement mirrored request path for shadowing with per-tenant sample_rate and bounded buffer to avoid overload
Stats: build sequential-test library in runtime service that can be shared by dedicated and hosted deployments
Console: new dashboard tiles for cohort health, per-metric trends, and a timeline of gate decisions
Ops: author playbook and automate Slack + PagerDuty alerting on high-severity events
telemetry: Per-request trace id mapping between primary and shadow responses
Histogram buckets for latency for both primary and shadow paths
Per-metric sample counts, rolling means, variances, and KL divergence scores
Decision provenance blob stored in the events table and cross-linked to deployment config
Retention: keep full eval payload for 30 days, aggregates for 180 days
rollout_strategy: Stage 1: Shadow 5% traffic for 24 hours, collect metrics and run sequential tests every 10 minutes
Stage 2: If metrics pass soft thresholds for 24h, open canary at 10% user traffic with guarded auto-rollback
Stage 3: Gradual ramp to 50% over 2 hours with continued monitoring; abort if any high-severity metric triggers
Rollback mechanics: immediate full revert OR staged retraction (50% -> 0% in 10-minute steps) based on severity
Fallback: if model flavor mismatch detected, automatically route to pinned compatible model for the affected tenant
testing_plan: Unit tests for sequential-test library covering Type I/II error characteristics
Integration tests that simulate drift scenarios using synthetic prompts and check rollback actions
Load test shadowing pipeline under 2x peak shadow rate to validate bounded buffers
Canary in staging workspace with production-captured but scrubbed traffic for 48 hours
Chaos test: inject delays/errors in shadow path and ensure primary path SLO unaffected
risks_and_mitigations: False positives causing unnecessary rollbacks: mitigate with alpha-spending + minimum effect size and human-in-the-loop for P2 alerts
Telemetry overload: enforce sample_rate caps and pre-aggregation at edge to reduce cardinality
Data leakage in shadow path: ensure PII scrubbing and use tenant-scoped keys for logs
Model mismatch causing failures: validate model contract (input schema, tokenizer, special tokens) before accepting into gate
Operational complexity: provide a simplified default policy for self-serve customers and advanced knobs for enterprise
